chapterInfo.content:
28
Ɛhe na nyansa firi? Mpeepee Nyankopɔn nyansa mu
1Aane dwetɛ wɔ ne nkommena,
na afa wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhorɔ.
2Dadeɛ nso wɔtu no fam,
na wɔnane aboɔ yɛ kɔbere.
3Onipa ma esum to twa,
na ɔhwehwɛ kɔduru akyirikyiri
pɛ sum kabii ne sunsum mu aboɔ.
4Ɔtu nkoron deɛ obi nteɛ hɔ,
anammɔn a ɛtwam werɛ firi no,
ɔsensɛne hɔ, ɔdi ahim deɛ ɔdasani biara nnie hɔ.
5Asase wɔ hɔ yi, aduane firi mu ba,
na n’ase nso, ɔdane ani sɛ ogya.
6Hoaboɔ dabea ne n’aboɔ no mu,
na sikafuturo nso wɔ hɔ.
7Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɔkɔdeɛ nnim,
na akorɔma ani nhunuu da,
8anworanwora mmoa ntiatiaa soɔ,
na gyatabire mfaa hɔ.
9Ɔtene ne nsa ka ɔbohemmaa,
ɔbutu mmepɔ wɔ ne nhini mu.
10Ɔtwitwa aka abotan mu,
na n’ani hwɛ aboɔdenneɛ nyinaa.
11 # Hiob 28.25 Ɔsisi asuasu kwan na ansosɔ,
na adeɛ a ahunta no, ɔyi ba hann mu.
12Na nyansa deɛ, ɛhe na wɔbɛhu no,
na ɛhe na nhunumu afa wɔ?
13Ɔdasani nnim ne boɔ,
na wɔnhu no ateasefoɔ asase so.
14Ebunu donkodonko ka sɛ: Ɛnni me mu.
Na ɛpo ka sɛ: Ɛnni me hɔ.
15 # Mmb 3.14-15; 8.10-11 Wɔmfa sika amapa nsi ananmu nnye,
na wɔnkari dwetɛ ntua ne tiri boɔ.
16 # 1 Ah 9.28 Wɔnkari no Ofir sika so ntɔ,
wɔmfa apopobibireboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den ne hoaboɔ ntɔ.
17Wɔmfa sika ne ahwehwɛ nto ho,
na wɔmfa sika nnwinneɛ nsesa.
18Wɔmmɔ nhwene panin ne aboɔ a ɛhyerɛn din,
na nyansa boɔ sene nhwene pa deɛ.
19 # Eks 28.17 Etiopia asase so akrateboɔ ne no nsɛ,
na wɔmfa sika amapa nkyerɛ ne boɔ.
20Ɛnneɛ na ɛhe na nyansa firi ba?
Na ɛhe na nhunumu tenabea wɔ?
21Wɔde ahunta ateasefoɔ nyinaa aniwa,
wɔakata so ɔsoro nnomaa anim.
22Ɔyera amena ne owuo ka sɛ:
Yɛde yɛn aso ate ne nka.
23 # Mmb 8.22-31 Onyankopɔn na ɔhunu ne kwan mu,
na ɔno na ɔnim ne tenabea;
24na ɔno na ɔhwɛ asase awieeɛ,
ɔsoro ase nyinaa nso, ɔhunu.
25 # Hiob 26.10 Ɔhyɛɛ mframa duro too hɔ,
na ɔhyɛɛ nsuo sɛ ne nsusuiɛ teɛ no,
26berɛ a ɔhyɛɛ osuo ahyɛdeɛ,
na ɔyɛɛ ɔkwan maa n’aprannaa asraman no,
27ɛno na ɔhunuiɛ na ɔyii no adie;
ɔde sii hɔ na ɔpeepee mu.
28 # Dwom 111.10; Mmb 1.7 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ onipa sɛ:
Hwɛ, AWURADE ho suro, ɛno ne nyansa,
na bɔne ho dwanneɛ ne nhunumu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Aane dwetɛ wɔ ne nkommena,
na afa wɔ hɔ ma sika a wɔhorɔ.
Dadeɛ nso wɔtu no fam,
na wɔnane aboɔ yɛ kɔbere.
Onipa ma esum to twa,
na ɔhwehwɛ kɔduru akyirikyiri
pɛ sum kabii ne sunsum mu aboɔ.
Ɔtu nkoron deɛ obi nteɛ hɔ,
anammɔn a ɛtwam werɛ firi no,
ɔsensɛne hɔ, ɔdi ahim deɛ ɔdasani biara nnie hɔ.
Asase wɔ hɔ yi, aduane firi mu ba,
na n’ase nso, ɔdane ani sɛ ogya.
Hoaboɔ dabea ne n’aboɔ no mu,
na sikafuturo nso wɔ hɔ.

Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɔkɔdeɛ nnim,
na akorɔma ani nhunuu da,
anworanwora mmoa ntiatiaa soɔ,
na gyatabire mfaa hɔ.

Ɔtene ne nsa ka ɔbohemmaa,
ɔbutu mmepɔ wɔ ne nhini mu.
Ɔtwitwa aka abotan mu,
na n’ani hwɛ aboɔdenneɛ nyinaa.
Ɔsisi asuasu kwan na ansosɔ,
na adeɛ a ahunta no, ɔyi ba hann mu.

Na nyansa deɛ, ɛhe na wɔbɛhu no,
na ɛhe na nhunumu afa wɔ?
Ɔdasani nnim ne boɔ,
na wɔnhu no ateasefoɔ asase so.
Ebunu donkodonko ka sɛ: Ɛnni me mu.
Na ɛpo ka sɛ: Ɛnni me hɔ.
Wɔmfa sika amapa nsi ananmu nnye,
na wɔnkari dwetɛ ntua ne tiri boɔ.
Wɔnkari no Ofir sika so ntɔ,
wɔmfa apopobibireboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den ne hoaboɔ ntɔ.
Wɔmfa sika ne ahwehwɛ nto ho,
na wɔmfa sika nnwinneɛ nsesa.
Wɔmmɔ nhwene panin ne aboɔ a ɛhyerɛn din,
na nyansa boɔ sene nhwene pa deɛ.
Etiopia asase so akrateboɔ ne no nsɛ,
na wɔmfa sika amapa nkyerɛ ne boɔ.

Ɛnneɛ na ɛhe na nyansa firi ba?
Na ɛhe na nhunumu tenabea wɔ?
Wɔde ahunta ateasefoɔ nyinaa aniwa,
wɔakata so ɔsoro nnomaa anim.
Ɔyera amena ne owuo ka sɛ:
Yɛde yɛn aso ate ne nka.

Onyankopɔn na ɔhunu ne kwan mu,
na ɔno na ɔnim ne tenabea;
na ɔno na ɔhwɛ asase awieeɛ,
ɔsoro ase nyinaa nso, ɔhunu.
Ɔhyɛɛ mframa duro too hɔ,
na ɔhyɛɛ nsuo sɛ ne nsusuiɛ teɛ no,
berɛ a ɔhyɛɛ osuo ahyɛdeɛ,
na ɔyɛɛ ɔkwan maa n’aprannaa asraman no,
ɛno na ɔhunuiɛ na ɔyii no adie;
ɔde sii hɔ na ɔpeepee mu.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ onipa sɛ:
Hwɛ, AWURADE ho suro, ɛno ne nyansa,
na bɔne ho dwanneɛ ne nhunumu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
